excerpt.zh: 巨型船坞的第一阶段已经完工。等到各制造隔间安装在这一巨型框架上后，这个设施终有一天会成为全星系舰船制造的中心。
excerpt.en: The first stages of our Mega Shipyard is now complete. A vast framework awaits the installation of the manufacturing bays which will one day make this facility the shipbuilding capital of the galaxy.
